title: A 0-current minimizing in A with support in A has empty regular set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let A ⊆ ℝ^P, and let T ∈ 𝒟_0(U) be minimizing in A in the sense of the contract (IsMinimizingIn T A, Simon 7.1.1: T is integer multiplicity, and M_W(T) ≤ M_W(S) for every open W with closure W compact and ⊆ U and every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_0(U) with spt(S − T) a compact subset of A ∩ W; the condition ∂S = ∂T is vacuous in degree 0). If spt T ⊆ A, then reg T = ∅ (regularSet T = ∅, Simon 7.4.1 as frozen in the contract).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → T.support ⊆ A → regularSet T = ∅
